title: Determination SB/007/001/011: conversion of a dwelling into two units; material change of use and regularisation
jurisdiction: England (UK): Secretary of State determination / appeal / tribunal under the Building Act 1984 and Building Regulations; comparative test only, not Alberta
code_edition: Building Regulations 2010 (as amended): regulation 5(g) material change of use; regulations 4 and 14 (as cited)

facts.text: A full plans application made on 6 January 2014 was rejected by the Council on 12 May 2014 on the grounds that the proposals are a material change of use and do not comply with regulation 6 of the Building Regulations 2010.
The applicant's position is that earlier extensions were carried out under full building regulation and planning consents.
The council's list of items, as quoted in the letter, includes escape windows for ground-floor inner rooms, a legal boundary confirmation, a sound test, heat-loss calculations and upgrade items.
facts.locator: pp.3-4 numbered items B1, B4, E1, L1, L1B

facts.text: The Council states it has no record of the loft conversion and the glazed front extension and asks for details of when they were built and what permissions applied.

Determination: the work constitutes a material change of use under regulation 5(g); regularisation of the loft conversion cannot be required; the conservatory work needs no application for regularisation.
